All 18 rules were searched across the full document and the plan is submitted. Key routing notes:

- **Deviation candidates flagged for worker review:** 13.5 Liquidated Damages against us (p0208), the Termination for Convenience Fee (p0187), 10.4 Developed Software vesting Customer-paid work in M&I (p0185), 10.2 letting M&I withdraw non-Core Services at will (p0180), the mutual assignment bar in 22.4 (p0289), the all-caps warranty disclaimer (p0236) read against Art. 9, and the asymmetric indemnities in 14.2 (p0219/p0220).
- **Likely absent (all favourable to us):** non-compete, MFN, and any vendor audit right against Customer.
- **Note for de-duplication:** the termination fee appears under T4C, LD and MINCOMMIT; it should be redlined once only.
